steps.content: Shin's power is immense, but she isn't the Abyss itself. She can't inflict upon you the deepest despair, the kind you've already endured once before.
As the red light of your shackles impales her abdomen, through the wound you had bandaged yourself, her body is pinned to the ground, her tentacles thrashing wildly in vain.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Looks like humanity won this time.
The filth slowly recedes from her face, and you see those sea-blue eyes once more.
But this time, she looks at Pylgia, then at you, before breaking into a sardonic smile.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Humanity...? Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You... you two... you're perhaps the furthest thing from humans in this world.
She gazes at the red and blue light around you, laughing derisively.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: This inconceivable power of yours is proof enough.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No.
Your denial is swift and resolute. You know power. You've wielded many kinds—some yours, some not—and because of this, you know one thing with perfect clarity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm merely using it. I'm not tempted by it. I'll never deny my worth as a human... just for the sake of power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whatever its source, in human hands, power is just a means to achieve our goals.
Her tentacles make a last-ditch attempt to strike, but Pylgia notices and pins them to the ground with her harpoon.
In the red light of the shackles, her tentacles continue to dissolve, her body disintegrating.
As the tentacles of her god are about to abandon her, she finally shows a rare expression of fear.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: No... wait...
She reaches desperately for the retreating tentacles, only to watch them melt into black ichor.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Wait! Please, don't leave me!

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Watch out!
At her plea, you see the crumbling tentacles pause. Then, they suddenly reverse course, surging frantically back into her body!
If Pylgia hadn't shielded you, you would have been swept up in the retaliating tentacles.
But it seems Shin wasn't trying to attack you.
The torrent of tentacles rushes into her body, just like... what happened to the crew on the ship.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Careful, she's... fusing... with the Abyss...
Through the wild thrashing of tentacles, you barely make out Shin's voice.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Ah... ah... So... that's how it is...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: It would not accept me... because I never truly felt fear... or sorrow...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Then I must thank these two children... for granting me... true fear.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Yes... I am afraid. Afraid of living out a human life in mediocrity, unable to reach my ultimate ideal.
[Use Phase 3 art as CG? Preferably with some motion, some camera movement.]

Shin lifts her head, dark ichor streaking down her face. Although the wounds from your shackles haven't healed, you can sense an unmistakable shift in her. She's completely different from the foe you just fought.
From her emanates a pressure that could overwhelm the entire ocean, just like...
Just like that monster from the Abyss.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Thank you, my little guide... Thanks to you...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I finally... reached...
Pylgia decisively steps in front of you.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: She's fused... with that thing. No... we can't beat her. I'll hold her off, you have to get out.
But Shin shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: No need to be alarmed, children. You've helped me, and for that, you have my sincerest gratitude. Now, all I want is to return to its side.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Besides, I think... the reason you exist... is because it, too, wants to touch humanity. It wants to understand... So, you must keep trying.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Go. Understand, comprehend, experience... When the time is right, I will personally return from the Abyss... to welcome you.
Her body slowly sinks into the darkness, leaving only a pair of pale blue eyes that watch you with the same gentle warmth as before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll defeat you again, no matter how many times it takes... I'll protect everything I love, until I've destroyed the source of your existence...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...the it you keep speaking of.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: ...Is that so?
In this moment, something you've never seen before passes over her disappearing face: confusion and sorrow.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I shall be... looking forward... to that... day...
With those final words, her eyes dissolve into the wind.
